name: Luna Assistant
validation_scope: static build validation; runtime installation still required
runtime_test_required: Select the Google Nest media_player entity
Enable permission for the ESPHome device to perform Home Assistant actions
While the Nest speaks, say Ei Luna and confirm playback stops immediately
Confirm a fresh listening turn opens after the interruption
Confirm ordinary room noise does not create a new conversation turn
Confirm continuous conversation opens only after the Nest becomes idle
Confirm Wake Chime does not produce Parent bus is busy
Confirm Atom fallback when the external target is unavailable
Enable Internet search on an existing Luna Conversation
Ask for today's news and confirm a current grounded response
Keep Home Assistant control enabled and confirm a light command still works
Ask one prompt that combines a Home Assistant action and a current-information question
Ask for a fact that cannot be confirmed and verify Luna admits uncertainty
Ask for a current sports result and verify Luna searches instead of relying on model memory
